caption: The video captures a dancer with long dark braided hair, wearing a neon-yellow sleeveless top, pleated skirt, and yellow leg warmers, standing with her back to the camera and facing a large wall mirror on the right. The mirror shows her front, and the reflected figure tracks her movements closely, consistent with a single person. Her arms are already raised wide in a diagonal V, held with subtle drifts while her left heel lifts off the floor. The arms then rotate inward and upward toward a near-vertical overhead position as the hands rise. The elbows bend and the hands lower from overhead to head and shoulder level, briefly crossing in front of the chest. The posture settles into a flexed, bent-arm stance with fists raised near the shoulders, with small up-and-down pumping motions continuing. Throughout, the feet shift weight and spread apart while the torso stays oriented toward the mirror. The ceiling track lights, curtain, and white walls appear stationary, and the visible motion is concentrated in the dancer's body.
relations: The mirror reflection tracks the dancer's body movements, maintaining consistent single-person correspondence throughout the sequence.
Arms rotate inward and upward from the diagonal V to overhead, then bend down to cross in front of the chest.
Feet shift weight and spread apart while the left heel lifts, keeping the torso oriented toward the mirror.
Ceiling lights, curtain, and white walls remain stationary while all visible motion concentrates in the dancer's body.
